answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant game wherein each node must lock staking collateral at a decentralized liquidity wharf, routing assertions through a zero-knowledge verifiable delay. To prevent identity multiplication, a glacier lockup protocol enforces a multi-epoch delay, rendering any hollow assertion mathematically unprofitable. Under this subgame-perfect slashing matrix, the unique Nash equilibrium converges to honest participation, as the opportunity cost of adversarial manipulation asymptotically exceeds any cooperative payoff.
